Family Bingo Night
Family Bingo Night at HHS!
Date: November 3rd
Time: 6:00 – 7:45 PM
Location: HHS Cafeteria

Grab your lucky charms and bring the whole crew for an evening full of laughter, prizes, and classic Bingo fun! Join us at HHS for Family Bingo Night — where the numbers are random, but the good times are guaranteed!!

Enjoy rounds of exciting Bingo, snacks, and chances to win awesome prizes! Whether you’re a Bingo beginner or a seasoned pro, everyone is invited to play, cheer, and celebrate together.

Pre-registration only. No walk-ins.

Indoor Pickleball

Stay active and enjoy some friendly games of Pickleball inside this winter!
Pickleball is one of the most popular and fastest growing sports in the U.S. This easy to learn game is played similar to the game of tennis but with small paddles, a wiffle ball and a badminton size court. Don’t let the funny name fool you, Pickleball is a recreational game providing extraordinary physical fitness benefits for all ages.

Location: White River School Gym
Nets will be set-up on three courts and we encourage you to bring your own paddle. We have some paddles available if needed

Registration is required. No drop-in play. All abilities welcome.
Limited number of spaces available for each session.
Participants are limited to sign-up for 1 session, not both.

Indoor Ultimate Frisbee
Looking to learn some basic ultimate frisbee skills or maintain/improve your skills during the winter season while having a blast with a great group of people?  Join us in the Hartford High School gymnasium on Sunday nights from 7 - 9 pm for a fun, smaller scale, fast paced version of ultimate frisbee!   Players of all experience and ability levels welcome and encouraged to join.  Please bring a white and dark shirt (no gray) each week so that we can mix up teams.
